scope: All six control blocks only; operational screen, no significance or optimality claim.

formulas.median: Median of three measured block values per mode and metric; warmups excluded.
formulas.ratio_of_medians: median(on trial values) / median(off trial values)
formulas.paired_ratio: on value in pair i / off value in pair i
formulas.direction: Ratio >1 favors on for throughput; ratio <1 favors on for elapsed or first-output time.
formulas.mixed_long_context: Checked long-context duration includes prompt construction/tokenization before the long API request.
formulas.mixed_long_api: Recorded observation duration of the long chat-completions API request.
formulas.mixed_concurrent_short: Checked two-call automatic-tool roundtrip duration; output lengths and cache hits vary.

limitations: No separate C2 warmup: retain all three trials, including onset variability; diagnostic warmed profiles are not replacement controls.
First on block starts colder with inherited KV occupancy; restarts and consecutive blocks differ. No causal thermal/cache attribution.
Mixed probes have variable prompt/completion counts and 256-512 cached tokens; not isolated scheduler timings.
Startup allocator OOM warnings recovered before readiness and are distinct from zero measured-window failures.
No coding-quality, broad tool-quality, adaptive-confidence, runner-integration or 1M-workload validation is provided by these speed controls.

whole_run_short_speculation.scope: Three entire on-short client runs: includes all C1 warmups, measured C1 requests and concurrent pairs; not measured-only or per-workload attribution.
whole_run_short_speculation.position_order: Positions 1 through 5; metric labels are zero-based 0 through 4.
limits: Fifth-position survival is 337/1924; this does not prove K5 is wrong or establish an optimal verification length.
No marginal kernel cost, fixed-prefix counterfactual, confidence calibration or adaptive policy is measured here.
